run_predict_location_generated: run the predict_location_generated script to train a guide model on tourist-generated utterances
run_train_guide_supervised: run the script with --train-guide to train the guide model in a supervised way
run_train_tourist_rl: run the script with --train-tourist to train the tourist model using reinforcement learning
cache_tourist_utterances: cache tourist model utterances on a dataset using greedy or beam search decoding strategy
run_epoch_training_loop: run a training epoch that evaluates guide accuracy and optionally updates guide and tourist models
